# fw completion

> Reference of the fw completion command: Generate shell completion script. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/completion/

Generate shell completion script

## Usage

```bash
fw completion [bash|zsh|fish|pwsh]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw completion bash
fw completion zsh
fw completion fish
fw completion pwsh
```

The names come from the usage line.

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
